Population increased in Calderdale

The estimated population of Calderdale in 2024 was 210,929 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that Calderdale's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Calderdale increased by 2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Calderdale was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Calderdale

The average (median) age stayed at 42.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Calderdale has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Calderdale is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Calderdale's population of 210,929 usual residents was made up of:

  • 39,748 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.8%)
  • 129,891 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.6%)
  • 41,290 people aged 65 years and over, (19.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Calderdale has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (61.6% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Calderdale, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Calderdale
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Calderdale, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 108 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 1,958 births and 2,066 deaths in Calderdale.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 102 (0%). There were 9,002 people entering the area and 8,900 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Calderdale's population of 1,597 (0.8%) as a result of 2,096 people entering the area and 499 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Calderdale was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Calderdale in mid-2023 is 209,334.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 760 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 161 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 599 people.
